description: This is a unit test class for the AvroDateTimeMapper, testing the mapping functions for OffsetDateTime, LocalDateTime, and LocalDate to their ISO string representations.

classes.name: AvroDateTimeMapperTest
classes.description: Unit test class for AvroDateTimeMapper's date and time to string mapping methods.

methods.name: testMapOffsetDateTimeShouldReturnNullIfNullGiven
methods.description: Tests that mapping a null OffsetDateTime returns null.

methods.name: testMapOffsetDateTimeShouldReturnStringInIsoOffsetDateTimeFormat
methods.description: Tests that an OffsetDateTime is correctly mapped to an ISO 8601 string with offset.

methods.name: testMapLocalDateTimeShouldReturnNullIfNullGiven
methods.description: Tests that mapping a null LocalDateTime returns null.

methods.name: testMapLocalDateTimeShouldReturnStringInIsoLocalDateTimeFormat
methods.description: Tests that a LocalDateTime is correctly mapped to an ISO 8601 string without offset.

methods.name: testMapLocalDateShouldReturnNullIfNullGiven
methods.description: Tests that mapping a null LocalDate returns null.

methods.name: testMapLocalDateShouldReturnStringInIsoLocalDateFormat
methods.description: Tests that a LocalDate is correctly mapped to an ISO 8601 date string.
